audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer called every stage 'Skill' up to two items, flattening a lane that actually has an early edge for Orianna and one clear Lissandra window at 6. The content layer and the packet chart both say Orianna 1-2, skill 3-5, Lissandra 6.
audit.why: Kit-grounded: Command: Attack reaches 815 and Ice Shard 725, so the first two levels are a range war you win, and Glacial Path is 24s at rank 1 — she cannot close that gap on demand. Frozen Tomb at 120s is what buys her level 6.
audit.corrected: phases[0], [1] and [4] moved to match win[], with whys rewritten to argue their new sides.
sources: champ-data/_kits/lissandra.json (Q range 725, E cd 24/21/18/15/12, R cd 120/100/80)

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes said level 6 doubles your lane presence in the one stage the chart gives to Lissandra, and claimed 'a third of a health bar' with no source. phases[5].why repeated the same invented fraction.
audit.why: Her 6 is a 120s ultimate that either stuns you for a gank or makes her untargetable through your answer; yours is 110s at 410 range. And the kit gives no damage numbers.
audit.corrected: Spikes restated as mana, her gank window, and Luden's answering her engage; the fraction removed from phases[5].why.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page treated Glacial Path as the whole matchup and never mentioned the two abilities that actually decide fights: Ring of Frost is a 450-range root on 10s, and Frozen Tomb self-cast makes her untargetable and invulnerable while healing her.
audit.why: The self-cast is the single most important thing an Orianna can know here — a 110s Command: Shockwave has a delay, and she can go untargetable through it. And the root, not the claw, is what holds you for a gank.
audit.corrected: Both now stated in cooldowns, enemyWin, tradeBad, breakdown.late, dontsFull[2] and report[5]/report[8].
sources: champ-data/_kits/lissandra.json (W range 450/cd 10, R text and untargetable flag)

audit.why: 49.15% over 1703 games, matching the brief's games field.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit (catalogue defect 3), and dosFull[2].d told the reader Glacial Path gives a 'fifteen-second invitation' when it is 24s at rank 1 and 12s at rank 5 — a number that is wrong at every rank.
audit.why: At rank 1 the advice throws away nine seconds of free window; at rank 5 it invents three seconds that do not exist.
audit.corrected: Real per-rank numbers in cooldowns, dosFull[2].d, winCon and report[5].

audit.whatIsWrong: Trading advice never used the fact that both Qs share the same cooldown curve (7/6/5/4/3) while hers reaches 90 units less far.
audit.why: That is the concrete reason you win a straight poke exchange: identical tempo, shorter reach on her side.

audit.whatIsWrong: Lissandra is called 'he/his/him' in tldr, tradeGood, tradeBad, five phases[].why, two dosFull titles and two report entries, while the content layer correctly says 'her'.
dosFull[1].d was tradeGood pasted verbatim and dontsFull[2].d was tradeBad pasted under a title about wasting Shockwave on a wave — catalogue defect 2.
audit.why: Neither body answered its own title.
audit.corrected: Both rewritten; the don't now contrasts the 110s ultimate against her untargetable answer.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization named Zed as the Zhonya's trigger in a Lissandra matchup and carried no anti-heal despite the brief flagging Frozen Tomb's self-heal.
audit.why: Template leak plus the flagged missing interaction.
audit.corrected: Oblivion Orb keyed to the Frozen Tomb heal, Zhonya's kept but keyed to her lock.

notes: Chart: content win[] and the packet levelChart agreed exactly; phases[].side disagreed on rows 0, 1 and 4 only, so I moved those three and rewrote their whys in the same proposal. Rows 2, 3, 5 and 6 already matched and were left as verdicts — their whys were still edited for pronouns and for the unsourced 'a third of his bar' fraction, but no side moved. phases[].rating left alone. The most valuable correction on this page is the number: dosFull[2].d promised a 'fifteen-second invitation' off Glacial Path, which is 24s at rank 1 and 12s at rank 5 — wrong at every single rank, and in the direction that makes a reader step up too early late in the game. Second most valuable is Frozen Tomb's self-cast: untargetable and invulnerable while healing, which is the answer to a 110s Command: Shockwave and was nowhere on the page. The anti-heal interaction the brief flagged is consumed in report[8].t and breakdown.late. Content layer needed no edits — it is already Lissandra-specific, correctly gendered and consistent with win[]. No claim made anywhere about Cleanse, QSS or tenacity against Ring of Frost or Frozen Tomb; the kit does not carry it.
